exposure: Type of twin pregnancy (dichorionic vs. monochorionic)
Neonates with transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN)
cohort: 514 amniotic fluid samples from 132 dichorionic and 125 monochorionic twin pregnancies, obtained at cesarean section between 29 and 38 weeks of gestation.
finding: Amniotic lamellar body count (LBC) was significantly different between neonates with RDS, TTN, and controls, suggesting its potential as a predictor for neonatal respiratory complications in twin pregnancies.
